scope: native DSP including MIDI noteOns; excludes JUCE and host overhead
ordering: baseline first on even trials, current first on odd trials
setup: fresh engine prepared before each timed callback
named_model_comparison: current named model versus baseline Original with matching material, shape and wood

provenance.compiler:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.5.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin

limitations: Team compilation, rendering and native test workloads paused during final timing; ordinary desktop applications remained active.
No real-time thread scheduling or CPU affinity; measured wall-clock maxima include scheduler delays.
Complete native noteOn batch plus process is timed; JUCE MIDI dispatch, mixing, host and device overhead excluded.
Named guitars are compared with the old baseline Original at matching material, shape and wood; the old engine has no matching named measurement bank.
No finite set of observed maxima establishes a worst-case execution-time bound.
